dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I hate phố Bùi Viện so much. Every time I go there, I feel like I've been there before, but it's always a terrible experience.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? I think phố Bùi Viện has many interesting things. Maybe next time we should go together, I can show you some quieter cà phê places.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I don't like noise and crowds. I prefer yên tĩnh places where I can think, like when playing chess. But... if you know a yên tĩnh cà phê there, perhaps I'll consider it.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I know a small place in the corner, away from the crowds. They serve Russian cà phê, which might make you feel nostalgic for home.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Russian cà phê on phố Bùi Viện? I'm skeptical, but I'm curious. When do you want to go?
